communication_goal: 解释方案取舍并判断延迟是否可接受。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two coworkers look at a desk monitor showing two unlabeled simple bar shapes of unequal length. One open-handed questioning gesture, other explaining. Whole monitor including stand visible.

coverage_review.scope: W039 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W039.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：完整显示器与底座；未标注柱图不证明真实延迟数值。 前三词由对白提供语境证据，静态画面不能单独证明，不设局部框。 真实裁剪发现切边后按1254尺寸修正并增加6/1000边缘余量。
